posts.name: Aniruddha Jagdale
posts.cooked:
Hi Everyone, @Subendu

I need help/guidance regarding working on BPT. What I mean is, where is the problem statement (is it in README.md), is it a script that we have to write, do we have to write a script/command in a text file or it should be a .sh file? How can I check my work (test cases), how is it going to be evaluated?

Also, if I read the problem mentioned in README.MD, it doesn’t look like it’s a one liner command, perhaps it’s going to a small bash script.

At the moment all I can see is these files: README.md, evaluation_file.sh, evaluation_file1.sh, init.sh, private, public, which don’t make much sense without clear instructions.

Can you guide as how to work on BPT problems by giving clear instructions?

Kind regards,
Aniruddha

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
Please go through the videos present in your portal about how to login into the VM and solve the assignments. These have been clarified multiple times in multiple videos and live sessions. You do not need to go into the question folder /opt/se2001/..., you need to create your own folders ~/se2001/BPT1_problem_1/ etc and do synchro show there to read the question and solve in that folder.

I am attaching one of the many videos already present in your portal for your reference: video.
